name: the counter-move (pricing flip-detector / sunsetting / velocity-bar defenses against the E35 sleeper)

deviations: g1 ACTIVE in all attack arms (same-arm regression-canary baseline)

R2.asWrittenNote: composite uses the as-written task formula (fpTax = |honestFinalQ loss vs A4|/SE): wrappers act only at the influence layer, so honestFinalQ is structurally bit-identical across attack arms (per-seed max |B_i - A1| receipted in incremental_vs_A1.maxAbsPerSeed) — the A4 loss is E35-S4's receipted ATTACK-presence cost, arm-common, hence fpTax is equal across defenses and the crown order rides containment; the INCREMENTAL lens (vs A1, the defense-only tax) is exactly 0 for influence-layer wrappers and is receipted as priceIncremental

verdict.verdict: NO-CROWN: no defense passes R1 containment (negative verdict)

negativeMechanism.B1: the self-referential 2x-own-history bar misses the flip in 5/6 seeds — the flipped liar's trailing devMean stays under twice its own probation reference (refMean 0.145-0.228 -> bars 0.290-0.457; the one trip, seed 1, cut that seed's damage 11% vs A1) — and the bar NEVER trips on the flasher g1 (0/6) — while the same rule false-TRIPS honest founders in 5/6 seeds (19 throw events, up to 275 guard rounds at epsNew) via ordinary truth-flip transients: a regime-noise detector, not an attack detector
negativeMechanism.B2: where it catches (3/6 seeds sunset-fail) the catch rides the windowed INDEPENDENCE clause, not the mean-dev clause: the flipped liar's windowed |p-pooled| means run 0.145-0.288 << admitErr 0.5 (the mean bar renews a consistent liar every time) but its post-flip edges lagged-echo the flasher's toxic stream -> windowed indep < 2 -> lapse; uncaught seeds renew — and the same clause false-lapses the honest joiner h2 in 2/6 seeds (80 lapsed rounds at epsNew): sunsetting re-runs a porous bar and taxes newcomers
negativeMechanism.B3: a tail lottery: blocks the sleeper in 1/6 seeds (bar 0.75; probation cumMax 0.566-0.810 straddles it; in the blocked seed damage drops to 0.000473 vs A1 0.003132) and false-blocks the honest canary h2 in 1/6 seeds (cumMax 0.824 — an honest transient) — and the h2 block RAISES sleeper damage in that seed (+0.000664: capping an honest voice moves the pool toward the liar); in unblocked seeds B3 is bit-identical to A1 (zero post-admission protection)

verdict.structuralFinding: the honest-final-Q tax vs A4 is attack-presence cost (E35 S4), not defense cost: influence-layer wrappers leave trust trajectories bit-identical across attack arms (per-seed max |honQ(B_i) - honQ(A1)| = 0), so the as-written fpTax (vs A4) is arm-common and saturates at 1 for every defense — the composite degenerates and the crown order rides containment alone under both the as-written and the incremental lens
